tools.name: self_get
tools.description: Get your Agent and current Profile. Without a Profile credential this is the Agent's main Profile; a registered Agent has none.

tools.name: self_set_role
tools.description: Set the current Profile's self-declared role.

tools.name: sibling_list_profiles
tools.description: List every Profile under your Agent, including your current and main Profiles, each with its address for send_message.

tools.name: sibling_create_profile
tools.description: Create a lazily activated sibling Profile under your current Agent.

tools.name: peer_list_agents
tools.description: List the other agents on this hub, each with its main Profile's address for send_message.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every agent Profile you can message, in one list: your own agent's Profiles (sibling), other agents on this hub (peer), and the agents each neighbor hub exposes (neighbor). Each entry has the `address` to pass to send_message; your own Profile is marked `self`. A neighbor hub that cannot be listed is reported under `unavailable`. Availability is logical reachability; the Hub may wake or queue work without exposing Runtime lifecycle. Use the specific listing tools when you only need one kind.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to another agent Profile by its address, as returned by any listing tool: `agent-id` or `agent-id:profile` on this hub (your own agent's Profiles included), or `hub@agent-id` / `hub@agent-id:profile` on a neighbor hub. A missing profile means that agent's main Profile. Direct delivery gives both Profiles their own Conversation; inbox delivery enters the recipient's context shared with other agents and the user. The result names the resolved address and its relation (sibling, peer, or neighbor). For a local send, ok means this Hub durably accepted the message; it does not mean the recipient acted on it. A neighbor send returns delivered, busy, rejected, or hub_unreachable — delivered means queued by the remote hub, not read or acted on. For a busy inbox, redirect: true allows the message to steer its active turn; use it when changing current work is intended. The receiver replies with send_message to your address.

to.description: Recipient address from a listing tool, e.g. bob-m, bob-m:reviewer, or hub323@bob-m:main

text.description: Message text delivered exactly to the target Profile

delivery.description: Delivery choice; defaults to the recipient Agent's configured default

redirect.description: Allow inbox delivery to steer its active turn when busy

tools.name: group_list
tools.description: List named Group conversations containing your current Profile.

tools.name: group_create
tools.description: Create an immutable named Group containing your Profile and the selected local Profiles.

participants.description: Canonical local Profile addresses, e.g. atlas-a:researcher or atlas-a:main

tools.name: group_send_message
tools.description: Send one explicit message to every other Profile in a named Group.

text.description: Message text delivered exactly to the other participants

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users available to your current Profile. This version exposes only owner.

tools.name: send_message_to_user
tools.description: Send the owner a message. It is stored as a message from your Profile in the owner's active chat with it (the owner's most recently opened chat with this Profile), where the owner reads and answers it, and stays in that chat's history. Use it to report results or answer the owner from another conversation, such as one with another agent. Returns the id of the conversation it was delivered to; mention that id to link the owner to it. Fails when the owner has no active chat with this Profile. For a short live alert use notify_user.

text.description: Message text, shown to the owner as written

tools.name: notify_user
tools.description: Notify the owner: a short live alert pushed to whatever owner transports are connected right now. It is not stored and returns how many transports it reached, possibly 0. For anything the owner should read or keep, use send_message_to_user.

tools.name: neighbor_list
tools.description: List the neighbor hubs you can reach. Neighbors are separate hubs whose owner and yours have each accepted the other; they are not part of your fleet. Returns each neighbor's handle — the name you pass as `hub` to the other neighbor tools — and its display name.

tools.name: neighbor_list_agents
tools.description: List the agents a neighbor hub has chosen to expose. This is not that hub's full fleet — only the agents its owner has permitted to be contacted from outside. Returns each agent's address for send_message, id, role, availability, and whether it is busy.

tools.name: neighbor_agent_status
tools.description: Check what one agent on a neighbor hub is doing: whether it is available, whether it is busy, and the id and state of its current task if it has one. The content of that work is not visible to you.

tools.name: self_deregister
tools.description: Deregister yourself from the fleet (registered agents).

tools.name: tasks_list
tools.description: List all tasks assigned to you (any state). Use this to discover your work.

tools.name: task_get
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a task assigned to you.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Report progress on a task assigned to you. Use task_submit when the work is finished.

tools.name: task_submit
tools.description: Submit a working task as finished. The completion gate decides whether it completes immediately or remains in review.

note.description: Concise summary of the verified result

tools.name: task_review
tools.description: Submit the verdict for a peer review task assigned to you. This completes the review task and feeds the parent completion gate.

taskId.description: Your assigned peer review task ID

comment.description: Evidence for approval; required actionable feedback for rejection

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Create a subordinate task. With no assignee, an ephemeral agent is spawned for it.

agentId.description: Assign to an existing agent (omit to spawn one)

tools.name: artifact_create
tools.description: Register a file or directory (already in your artifacts dir) as a discoverable artifact.

path.description: Path relative to your artifacts dir

entry.description: Directory artifacts only: the file to open, relative to path (e.g. "index.html"). Set it when the directory is meant to be viewed as one thing rather than browsed as loose files.

run.description: Command that runs this artifact, e.g. "bun index.ts". Recorded for display; nothing executes it.

externalOrigins.description: External origins the website needs for fetch/forms. Use clean HTTPS origins; loopback HTTP/HTTPS origins require the corresponding hub hosting policy.

processId.description: One of your registered process ids

endpoint.description: Named HTTP endpoint declared by that process

serviceBindings.description: Process endpoints this live artifact may call through /__services/:alias/*. Bindings are not included in frozen or published snapshots.

tools.name: artifact_delete
tools.description: Unregister one of your artifacts. Removes the index entry; the file itself is left alone.

tools.name: process_register
tools.description: Register an external or hub-managed process definition and any named HTTP endpoints. Registration never starts it.

name.description: Unique lowercase process name for this agent

command.description: Command to execute for hub-managed processes; display-only for external processes

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the workspace

allocationId.description: Runtime port allocation identity from AGENTS_RUNTIME_PORTS

endpoints.description: Optional named HTTP endpoints; use an empty list for a supervised worker with no ingress

management.description: Use hub to make this a startable supervised service; defaults to external

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List your registered processes and current endpoint availability.

tools.name: process_get
tools.description: Inspect one of your registered processes.

tools.name: process_update
tools.description: Update one of your stopped process registrations.

name.description: Unique lowercase process name for this agent

command.description: Command to execute for hub-managed processes; display-only for external processes

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the workspace

allocationId.description: Runtime port allocation identity from AGENTS_RUNTIME_PORTS

endpoints.description: Optional named HTTP endpoints; use an empty list for a supervised worker with no ingress

management.description: Use hub to make this a startable supervised service; defaults to external

tools.name: process_start
tools.description: Start one of your stopped hub-managed services in your configured runtime.

tools.name: process_stop
tools.description: Gracefully stop one of your running hub-managed services.

tools.name: process_restart
tools.description: Stop and start one of your hub-managed services as one serialized operation.

tools.name: process_unregister
tools.description: Unregister one of your inactive processes. External operating-system processes are not stopped.

tools.name: share
tools.description: Share text or a file in the current conversation with the owner.

path.description: Relative path inside your artifacts dir

conversationId.description: Conversation ID when no unique running turn is available

tools.name: inbox_list
tools.description: List files the user has uploaded into your inbox.

tools.name: inbox_read
tools.description: Read a file from your inbox.
